definitions.gloss: grand prize, top award, grand prix
definitions.explanation: The highest or most prestigious award in a competition, festival, or contest. Used for literary prizes, music awards, film festivals, and other award ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {大賞|たいしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
この{作品|さくひん}がレコード{大賞|たいしょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: This work was chosen for the Japan Record Award.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}から{千|せん}を{超|こ}える{応募|おうぼ}があり、{審査|しんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{彼|かれ}の{小説|しょうせつ}が{大賞|たいしょう}に{輝|かがや}いた。
examples.english: There were over a thousand entries from across the country, and after judging, his novel won the grand prize.

notes:
{大賞|たいしょう} is the top prize in a competition or award ceremony.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大賞|たいしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}する: to win the grand prize
- {大賞|たいしょう}に{輝|かがや}く: to be honored with the grand prize
- {大賞|たいしょう}に{選|えら}ばれる: to be selected for the grand prize

WELL-KNOWN AWARDS:
- レコード{大賞|たいしょう}: Japan Record Award (music)
- {芥川賞|あくたがわしょう}: Akutagawa Prize (literature; uses {賞|しょう} not {大賞|たいしょう})
- {新語|しんご}・{流行語|りゅうこうご}{大賞|たいしょう}: Buzzword of the Year Award

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {賞|しょう}: prize, award (general)
- {大賞|たいしょう}: the top/grand prize specifically
- {最優秀賞|さいゆうしゅうしょう}: best excellence award (similar rank)
